project_type: Laravel 13 REST API with Sanctum authentication
build_system: Composer with Laravel framework, Pest for testing
verification_instructions: 1. Run migrations: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed; 2. Test login: curl POST /api/v1/auth/login with admin/admin123; 3. Run feature tests: php artisan test; 4. Test endpoints with Postman/curl using Bearer token
snapshot_or_generated_files: database/migrations/*.php are versioned; storage/app/public/* for uploaded images are not versioned; config/l5-swagger.php generates OpenAPI docs
environment_constraints: Shared hosting cPanel deployment (no workers/daemons); timezone Asia/Jakarta; bcmath for money calculations; no N+1 queries (eager loading required); rate limiting on login and upload endpoints
contribution_requirements: Response format: {success, message, data, errors}; all error messages and endpoints in Bahasa Indonesia; Form Requests for validation; API Resources for output; Service classes for business logic; middleware role:pemilik for owner-only endpoints; user_id auto-filled from auth; pagination ?page&per_page (default 15); date filters ?from&to; ERD schema is frozen except deleting water_logs and making specific columns nullable
key_patterns: AuthController pattern: uses ApiResponse trait, LoginRequest for validation, UserResource for output, Sanctum tokens; Models use proper casts (decimal:2 for money, date for dates, enum for UserRole); Tests use RefreshDatabase, Pest syntax (test('description', function(){})), factory() for fixtures; Exception Handler converts all API errors to {success, message, errors} format in Bahasa Indonesia
directory_structure: app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/ for API controllers; app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/ for form requests; app/Http/Resources/Api/V1/ for JSON resources; app/Services/ for business logic; app/Http/Middleware/ for custom middleware; app/Enums/ for enums; app/Models/ for Eloquent models; database/migrations/ for schema; database/seeders/ for data; database/factories/ for test fixtures; tests/Feature/Api/V1/ for API tests; routes/api.php for /api/v1 routes; config/ for configuration files
